hypotheses.D0_exact_composition_reconstructs_each_l: The all-role compositional adjoint has gradient cosine at least 0.999 and relative error at most 0.02 at every source layer.
hypotheses.D1_local_role_factorization_is_exact: The five Q1/K1/Q2/K2/value derivatives recompose native attention with maximum relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.D2_eight_nearby_attention_blocks_are_suf: MLP paths plus full attention in the next eight blocks reach median gradient cosine at least 0.90 at every source layer.
hypotheses.D3_qk_is_a_stable_same_position_grammar: All suffix Q/K roles reach median gradient cosine at least 0.85 at every source layer.
hypotheses.D4_qk_beats_value: Q/K exceeds value-only gradient cosine by at least 0.10 at every source layer.
hypotheses.D5_rank64_is_directionally_sufficient: The exact-gradient top-64 finite intervention moves the semantic score in the intended direction on at least 90 percent of sites at every source layer.
hypotheses.D6_rank64_recovers_most_rank1024_effect: The mean top-64 finite semantic shift is at least 80 percent of the top-1024 shift at every source layer.
hypotheses.D7_single_neurons_are_not_sufficient: The mean top-1 finite semantic shift is below 25 percent of the top-1024 shift at every source layer.
hypotheses.D8_depth_does_not_make_native_coalitions: The first tested rank reaching 90 percent of the top-1024 mean effect does not increase from Layer 0 through Layer 3.
